summary: [correctness] `ledger compact` names every failure of the archive pass LEDGER_COMPACT_INCOMPLETE, including a preview and a failure before the first version moved, where nothing was written. Real call at 8e9de889 (debug build): a ledger whose `kind=*` directories are mode 000, `canon ledger compact --json` (the preview, no --commit) -> exit 1, code LEDGER_COMPACT_INCOMPLETE, retryable false, hint 'versions already moved stay in the archive', no meta.next; the cause is `scan_kind` failing with EACCES before any move (canon-store archive.rs compact_kind -> scan_kind), and a dry-run never moves anything. The brief F1 acceptance says a call whose name ends in _INCOMPLETE and leaves no partial effect fails; F5 gives INCOMPLETE only to a compaction that moved some. `ledger.rs::compact` wraps `tier.compact(dry_run)` in one closure for all three call sites (preview at ledger.rs:142/175/242, commit at 216). Fix: INCOMPLETE only when the commit has moved at least one version (the error must carry the moved count, as KindCompaction.moved does); a preview and a first-move failure are a FAILED answer, or the codes-stored read codes (DENIED/UNAVAILABLE, exit 2) for the unreadable ledger; add the `read_status` next only on INCOMPLETE. Add a test: preview over an unreadable kind directory is not LEDGER_COMPACT_INCOMPLETE.
